nodes.label: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding
nodes.author: Xin Cheng, Xingkai Yu, Chenze Shao, Jiashi Li, Yunfan Xiong, et al. (DeepSeek-AI, Peking University)
nodes.rationale: Speculative decoding framework combining semi-autoregressive generation (parallel backbone + sequential head) with confidence-scheduled verification. Deployed in DeepSeek-V4 serving; 60–85% per-user speedup vs. MTP-1 baseline.

nodes.label: Semi-Autoregressive Generation (DSpark)
nodes.rationale: Two-stage draft: (1) parallel backbone (DFlash) produces all γ logits in one pass; (2) lightweight sequential head refines with inter-token dependencies. Mitigates suffix decay and multi-modal collisions in parallel drafters.

nodes.label: Confidence-Scheduled Verification (DSpark)
nodes.rationale: Hardware-aware prefix scheduler dynamically tailors verification length based on prefix survival probabilities and engine throughput profiles. Prevents verification waste under high-concurrency loads.

nodes.label: Speculative Decoding (General Framework)
nodes.rationale: Draft model proposes γ tokens; target model verifies all in one pass via rejection sampling. Accepts longest prefix consistent with target distribution + one bonus token. Preserves target distribution exactly. Per-token latency: L = (T_draft + T_verify) / τ.

nodes.label: Autoregressive vs. Parallel Drafters (Trade-offs)
nodes.rationale: Autoregressive: high τ but T_draft ∝ γ (sequential bottleneck). Parallel: T_draft independent of γ but low τ due to independence assumption. DSpark unifies both via semi-autoregressive architecture.

nodes.label: DSpark: Speculative Decoding Framework
nodes.rationale: Semi-autoregressive architecture combining parallel backbone with lightweight sequential head to mitigate suffix decay in speculative decoding; hardware-aware prefix scheduler dynamically routes verification based on system load and confidence estimates.

nodes.label: Parallel Backbone (Draft Generation)
nodes.rationale: Deep transformer layers enabling high-capacity first-token prediction; O(1) latency allows deeper networks than autoregressive alternatives, yielding substantial accuracy margin at position 1.

nodes.label: Sequential Stage (Markov/RNN Head)
nodes.rationale: Lightweight autoregressive correction module conditioning on previously sampled tokens; mitigates multi-modal collision and rapid acceptance decay typical of pure parallel generation.

nodes.label: Confidence Head
nodes.rationale: Predicts per-position prefix survival probability; trained with binary cross-entropy against analytical acceptance rate derived from total variation distance between draft and target distributions.

nodes.label: Sequential Temperature Scaling (STS)
nodes.rationale: Post-hoc calibration addressing neural overconfidence; performs 1D grid search per position to minimize Expected Calibration Error of cumulative product while preserving token rankings.

nodes.label: Hardware-Aware Prefix Scheduler
nodes.rationale: Formulates verification length selection as global throughput maximization; greedily admits draft tokens sorted by survival probability, using profiled SPS(B) capacity curve to balance batch size against expected acceptance.

nodes.label: Training Objective (Three-Term Loss)
nodes.rationale: Combines cross-entropy (Lce), distribution-matching via total-variation (Ltv), and confidence loss (Lconf); position-weighted by exp(-(k-1)/γ) to emphasize early block positions with higher leverage.

nodes.label: DeepSeek-V4 Production Deployment
nodes.rationale: Real-world deployment with 3 MoE layers, γ=5 block size, asynchronous scheduling to integrate with Zero-Overhead Scheduling (ZOS) and CUDA graphs; variable-length kernel modifications for sparse attention.

nodes.label: Speculative Decoding (General Concept)
nodes.rationale: Decouples token proposal from verification; draft model generates candidates, target model verifies via rejection sampling; maintains exact target distribution while accelerating generation.

nodes.label: Parallel Generation Suffix Decay Problem
nodes.rationale: Pure parallel drafters suffer rapid acceptance decay at later positions due to multi-modal collision; marginalizing over all possible prior tokens produces inconsistent suffix combinations.

nodes.label: Semi-Autoregressive Design Rationale
nodes.rationale: Combines high-capacity parallel backbone for initial token with dependency-modeling sequential head for subsequent tokens; resolves trade-off between capacity advantage and suffix coherence.

nodes.label: Total Variation Distance for Acceptance Rate
nodes.rationale: Per-step acceptance probability equals 1 - 0.5 * ||p_d - p_t||_1; direct proxy for acceptance rate; minimizing total variation distance in training directly maximizes expected acceptance.

nodes.label: Non-Anticipating Property (Losslessness)
nodes.rationale: Admission decisions must not depend on future candidate tokens; early-stopping mechanism in Algorithm 1 enforces causality by breaking when throughput drops, preventing selection bias.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Scheduling for ZOS Integration
nodes.rationale: Approximates verification capacity using confidence predictions from two steps prior; enables seamless Zero-Overhead Scheduling integration while maintaining rank-preserving token selection.

nodes.label: Variable-Length Kernel Optimization
nodes.rationale: Decouples physical execution from logical sequence tracking; flattens tokens across requests and conveys intra-sequence dependencies via marker tensor in sparse attention; enables dynamic routing without GPU under-utilization.

nodes.label: Throughput-Interactivity Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Under resource constraints with fixed KV-cache and limited user traffic, maximizing per-GPU token throughput and per-user generation speed become correlated rather than competing objectives.
